# Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 Summary

## Overview
The Liberal Democrats' 2024 manifesto, titled "For a Fair Deal," presents a comprehensive vision for transforming British politics and addressing what they describe as years of Conservative neglect across healthcare, the economy, environment, and public services.

## Key Themes

### Economy
The party pledges responsible fiscal management while investing in green infrastructure and renewable energy. Key proposals include replacing business rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy, creating Lifelong Skills Grants of £5,000 for adult education, and reforming the apprenticeship levy. They commit to fixing the UK-EU trading relationship and implementing fair taxation, including reversing bank tax cuts and increasing the Digital Services Tax.

### Healthcare
The manifesto promises everyone the right to see a GP within seven days (24 hours for urgent cases), requiring 8,000 additional GPs. They pledge to guarantee NHS dental access for urgent care, boost cancer survival rates with a 62-day treatment guarantee, and place mental health professionals in every school. Social care reform includes introducing free personal care and creating a Royal College of Care Workers.

### Environment
Central to their platform is ending the sewage scandal by transforming water companies into public benefit companies and banning executive bonuses until pollution ends. They commit to net zero by 2045, with 90% renewable electricity by 2030. A ten-year home insulation programme and rooftop solar expansion are proposed alongside planting 60 million trees annually.

### Housing
The party targets building 380,000 homes annually, including 150,000 social homes, through ten new garden cities. They promise to ban no-fault evictions, abolish residential leaseholds, and end rough sleeping within the Parliament.

### Education
Proposals include placing mental health professionals in every school, increasing per-pupil funding above inflation, reinstating maintenance grants for disadvantaged students, and introducing a "Tutoring Guarantee" for disadvantaged pupils.

### Political Reform
The manifesto advocates proportional representation via Single Transferable Vote for MPs and English councillors, votes at 16, scrapping voter ID requirements, capping political donations, and reforming the House of Lords with democratic mandate.

### International Affairs
The party commits to fixing EU relations through a four-stage roadmap ultimately aiming for Single Market membership, supporting Ukraine, returning international development spending to 0.7% of national income, and advocating for an immediate Israel-Gaza ceasefire with recognition of Palestinian statehood.

### Immigration
They propose scrapping the Rwanda scheme and Illegal Migration Act, creating safe legal routes for refugees, lifting the asylum seeker work ban after three months, and replacing salary thresholds with merit-based work visas.
